about: Caran d'Ache is a brand that can be found in every Swiss Office. Be it in the quality segment for 'normal' ballpoint pens or the royal class of the fountain pens of the Léman line with a unique elegance paired with the highest Swiss quality. All Caran d'Ache products are manufactured in Switzerland.

Konrad S. is a premium office collection crafted from high-quality PU leather, designed and manufactured in the UAE. The range includes sleek tissue boxes and complete desktop sets. The Konrad S. stationery collection shines with its simple, timeless design, perfect for any office or home office.
